sources.entry: Quest for Duskara - Single-player island strategy game where you build a town, trade, raise an army, and conquer a 15-city archipelago.

summary.one_liner: Quest for Duskara is an open-source single-player island strategy game for macOS in which you build a town, trade, raise an army, and conquer a 15-city archipelago.
summary.what_it_does: You start with one small island town and build an economy by placing and upgrading Houses, Farms, Factories, Piers, and Barracks on a 3 × 3 board. Time passes in days (one every ten seconds), during which buildings produce resources, soldiers eat, and enemy cities make moves. You can trade at the Harbor Market for food and skill, or sail from the world map to attack other cities. Captured towns share gold, food, and skill, while their soldiers stay stationed locally. Easy, Medium, and Hard settings change the starting stockpile, and the campaign ends when you capture Duskara or lose your last town. The town has four visual themes (Village, Desert, Mountains, Forest) that change looks only, not rules.
how_to_run: In Xcode, select the Quest For Duskara scheme and My Mac, then press Run (⌘R)
If prompted for signing, choose your own team under Signing & Capabilities (a free Personal Team works)
notable: Seeded generator lays out a coherent 15-city archipelago for each campaign
Captured towns share resources while troops stay stationed locally
Code is organized into Models, ViewModels, Views, and Tests folders
Built with SwiftUI interface and a 3D town rendered with RealityKit and Metal
caveats: Built with Xcode 26.6; running from source requires Xcode
README describes the build as v0.02 in its screenshots section
